description: The tokenizer character classes of AGSC-06-23 pinned exactly where ports diverge. Combining marks are token characters (General_Category M*), so a Devanagari word stays one token instead of splitting at every mark; Nd digits are token characters while No and Nl forms — the superscript two and the Roman numeral eight — are boundaries; ASCII lower-casing maps only U+0041..U+005A, so the Greek capital sigma is kept as authored and never case-folded; tokens shorter than two Unicode code points (m, x) are dropped. A port choosing \p{L}\p{N} or \w instead of L*, Nd and M* disagrees with this vector.
